trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done, so there is no separate task here — it is the reward for finishing everything else. The long pole is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold, so treat that as the real final boss and let this one follow it. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; Exophase GTA VI trophy list.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing, Jason's first job, and this pops during the story without any extra work. Just play the opening as directed and it unlocks before the map fully opens up. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1 to its end. Nothing optional is needed — the trophy is awarded when the chapter closes. While you are still in Chapter 1, stop at the meditation spot at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude, the one thing in this game that may not wait for you. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Keep playing the story in order; side activities can wait for the free-roam clean-up after the finale. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete every mission in Chapter 3. This is a story trophy, so it unlocks automatically at the chapter's end with no extra requirements. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full and the trophy is yours at the chapter close. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the end of the story. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission. Once it pops, the whole of Leonida stays open for free roam, and the 100% completion checklist unlocks — that is when the real trophy hunt begins. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the campaign, so just keep following the story missions in order. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like the other mission trophies, it pops automatically when the mission ends — no special approach needed. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is awarded at the end of the mission as part of the story, so there is nothing to prepare in advance. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy unlocks when the mission is done, as with every other story-mission trophy. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It pops at the end of the mission; the airport setting also makes it a good moment to remember the Catch Me if You Can trophy, which needs an unscheduled departure from the same airport. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Awarded automatically at the mission's end, like all the story trophies. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, tracked on the in-game checklist that unlocks after the final mission (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). You do not need literally everything — for example only 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count toward it — but it is still the longest grind in the game, roughly 200 hours to the platinum overall. Work the checklist, not your memory: it shows exactly what is left. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% completion checklist.
Open Touch Pad, Progress, 100% Completion and work down the list it shows.
Complete 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 challenges — the checklist counts those, not the full totals.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts cover stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps — 397 exist in total, so you need a little over half. Track them from Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find undiscovered spots under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots. Stunt jumps are the easiest bulk source; knock out the ones near roads you already use. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Open Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see stunt locations on the map.
Clear stunt jumps first — there are 130 of them and they are the simplest.
Add under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps until the counter hits 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. You do not need to win or finish anything — one attempt at each counts. Early in the game, sample whatever the map offers near you: a race, a drone race, fishing, an arcade game, the shooting range, a stunt, and the rest, until all nine are ticked. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges. There are two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. This is one of the hardest silvers, so save it for after the story when you can focus on aim and loadouts. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GamesFuze GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GamesFuze — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Visit both ranges: Rodgers Ranch in Port Gellhorn and Griffin in Balsero.
Work through every challenge tier and earn gold on each.
Check locked challenges on the map for their unlock conditions, then return for them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find the locations under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win — a clean line beats raw speed on the tight ones. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating the same race does not count — the wins must be at 20 distinct locations, tracked under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most spots let you hire a car; if you bring your own, mind its rating and upgrade it at mod shops. Start with the short, simple circuits and save the long ones for when your driving is warmed up. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on, Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg — fish in the marked area until you land one big enough. You need a boat with a fishing rod; if you have none, take one in the area. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any arcade game once. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it to its end — no high score needed. It is one of the quickest bronzes and counts toward Master of None too. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole stranger mission strand, ending with the final mission. Stranger strands appear as you explore Leonida, so keep an eye on the map for Andy's marker and return whenever a new mission shows. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand through to its final mission, Maritime Disputes. Work his missions in order as they appear on the map; the trophy pops when that last mission ends. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. As with the other strands, his missions unlock one after another — just keep answering his marker until the strand closes. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each give you one strand and a bronze for their finale, and further strangers fill the remaining slots. Explore the map, answer every stranger marker, and this silver lands once the eighth strand is done. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's strand to its final mission. His jobs revolve around a vehicle wish list — find and deliver the cars he asks for, and the strand closes with the finale. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission. His jobs involve tracking down kitty litter lab locations across the state, so follow the markers he gives you and clear each one until the finale unlocks. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and do the one at Jason's house in Chapter 1 before the story moves on, because it is the only trophy in the game flagged as possibly missable. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played, so stay until it finishes. Track found spots on the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida, and progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: In Chapter 1, meditate at the spot at Jason's house — this one may not be available later.
Visit the other 17 spots and wait for each zen animation to finish.
Check Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations for any spot still missing.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Follow Bret's missions and markers; when he points you at a specific animal, track it down and take it. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets scattered around Leonida; collect every card in any three sets. Track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward the set, so sell freely. For 100% completion you will need 15 sets anyway, so this silver lands on the way. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on Jason or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it) to scan 100 locations. Scannable spots include 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than enough for the 100 you need. Check progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the count climbs on its own. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GamesFuze GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GamesFuze — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are skill-based feats listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges — browse the list, pick the easy ones first (driving, shooting and exploration feats), and let the rest come naturally. For 100% completion you need 70, so keep going past 50. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a four-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Work as a pair: keep moving, break line of sight, and use alleys, tunnels or water to shake the search. A fast car and a quiet hiding spot do more than a shootout. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, hit each fast, and keep the heat on all the way — losing the cops or getting caught resets the chain. A getaway car parked outside each stop helps. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — getting inside one or scanning it counts as a discovery. This comes naturally through the story, but you can push it along by driving everything you see and scanning parked cars. Track discoveries under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang hideout or a heavy police response — trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. Pick off the closest targets first and keep moving so you are not caught reloading mid-focus. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — take a plane and leave without following any scheduled flight. Grab a small aircraft on the airfield, get it airborne and fly clear of the airport. Expect a wanted level on the way out, so be ready to climb fast. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get behind the controls of a Rhino tank and stir up trouble with it — the trophy's own joke gives it away. Find a Rhino at a military site, take it for a spin, and let the chaos follow; the trophy pops once you have had your fun in it. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards' sightlines, move slowly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a clean run is the only one that counts. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big heist targets — plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the cash and get clear before the response closes in. A fast getaway car and a pre-planned route matter more than firepower. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GamesFuze GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GamesFuze — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level that follows. Ramming it off the road or blocking it works; just be ready for the guards and the police response. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. The story takes you through much of the map, so mop up the rest in free roam: drive every region, visit the coasts, the swamps and the small towns, and watch the map fill in. Flying helps for the far corners. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Gangs run their own off-the-books operations around the state — find one per gang, hit it and get out. Work through them gang by gang so none is missed. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy pops for the moment, not for any challenge. A quiet breather between the harder trophies. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, line up a fast car outside, and go through the window in style. Expect a wanted level and a repair bill. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there, play a full game and follow through on your throws — the trophy is for the visit and the game, not a perfect score. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength with both Jason and Lucia. Train at the gym with each character until their strength stat is maxed — it takes repeated sessions, so fold gym visits into your routine between missions rather than grinding it all at once. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make a story choice and live with it. This pops when a decision point in the game resolves — just play the story and choose when asked; there is no wrong answer for the trophy, only the consequences in the story. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy list.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. The name says it all: when an attempt goes wrong, go straight back and do it again — the trophy rewards the retry, not the first success. It will usually pop on its own during a long playthrough. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger one of Leonida's strange encounters — the kind that leaves you asking what just happened. Explore the odd corners of the map, especially at night and off the beaten track, and the moment will find you. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock down your targets. Find a group of pedestrians, drive past slowly, and swing as you pass. Do it somewhere with a crowd and room to drive through. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — hand them to your laundering contacts over time until the total hits $250,000. It accumulates across the whole playthrough, so keep laundering after every big score instead of letting bills pile up. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops. Any shop counts — clothes, weapons, car parts, food. Find shops under Touch Pad, Style. If you are close to the total late in the game, buy ammo and upgrades you actually want rather than wasting money. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight garage properties, for $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800). Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Each garage adds a parking spot, which also helps with On the Spot. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; EGamers GTA 6 Trophy List.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Take any vehicle you are driving to a Pay 'N' Spray or mod shop and register it there, as long as you have a free parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy more garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out of spots. Registered vehicles can then be delivered to you by Scooter Bros for a small fee. Sources: Push Square GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Scoop GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTA Scoop — GTA 6 Trophies & Achievements
